```{=html}
</style>

<div class="fp-hero">
  <div>
    <h1>Influenza Forecasting</h1>
    <div class="fp-sub">Full-season outlook • <span id="fp-season-label">2025-2026</span></div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="fp-controls">
  <div>
    <div class="fp-control-label">Region</div>
    <select class="fp-select" id="fp-region"></select>
  </div>
  <div>
    <div class="fp-control-label">Metric</div>
    <select class="fp-select" id="fp-metric" disabled>
      <option>Percent ED Visits</option>
    </select>
  </div>
  <div>
    <div class="fp-control-label">View Mode</div>
    <div class="fp-toggle" id="fp-viewmode">
      <button data-v="intervals">Intervals</button>
      <button class="active" data-v="trajectories">Trajectories</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div>
    <div class="fp-control-label">Past seasons</div>
    <div class="fp-toggle" id="fp-pastseasons">
      <button data-v="last">Last year</button>
      <button class="active" data-v="all">All</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="fp-cards">
  <div class="fp-card fp-trend-card" id="fp-trend-card">
    <div class="fp-card-label">Epidemic trend</div>
    <div class="fp-trend-head">
      <span class="fp-trend-icon" id="fp-trend-icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      <span class="fp-trend-large" id="fp-trend-label">—</span>
    </div>
    <div class="fp-trend-stat" id="fp-trend-stat"></div>
    <div class="fp-card-sub" id="fp-trend-sub"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="fp-card">
    <div class="fp-card-label">Epidemic level</div>
    <div class="fp-level-line">
      <span class="lbl">Current:</span>
      <span class="val" id="fp-level-current">—</span>
    </div>
    <div class="fp-level-line">
      <span class="lbl">In 4 weeks:</span>
      <span class="val" id="fp-level-future">—</span>
    </div>

    <div class="fp-level-warning" id="fp-level-warning" hidden
         title="Reported values in this location jump around a lot from week to week (often because of small numbers or weeks reported as zero), so the level may change quickly.">

</div>

<div class="fp-chart-card">

    <div>
      <h3>ED Visits Forecast</h3>
      <div class="sub">Full-season projection • Data source: NSSP</div>
    </div>

  </div>

  <div class="fp-legend">
    <div class="fp-legend-item"><span class="fp-legend-swatch" style="background:#0f172a"></span> Observed data through current week</div>
    <div class="fp-legend-item"><span class="fp-legend-swatch" style="background:#64748b"></span> <span id="fp-last-year-label">Last year</span></div>
    <div class="fp-legend-item" id="fp-older-legend"><span class="fp-legend-swatch" style="background:#a8b4c4"></span> <span id="fp-older-label">Earlier seasons</span></div>
    <div class="fp-legend-item" style="color:#2563eb"><span class="fp-legend-swatch dash"></span> Ensemble forecast <span id="fp-forecast-legend-detail"></span></div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(async function () {
  // Card data is built by scripts/build_card_data.py and published to the cards/data branch, which
  // the deployed site reads: DATA_REPO's branch on its custom domain, or <owner>/<repo>'s on
  // <owner>.github.io/<repo>/ (e.g. a fork). A local preview reads data/cards/ next to this page,
  // and a ?data=<url> query parameter overrides all of these.
  const DATA_REPO = "reichlab/metrocast-dashboard";
  function dataRoot() {
    const override = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("data");
    if (override) return override.replace(/\/?$/, "/");
    const raw = repo => `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${repo}/refs/heads/cards/data/`;
    if (location.protocol === "file:" || ["localhost", "127.0.0.1", "[::1]"].includes(location.hostname)) {
      return "data/cards/";
    }
    const owner = location.hostname.match(/^([^.]+)\.github\.io$/);
    const repo = location.pathname.split("/")[1];
    return owner && repo ? raw(`${owner[1]}/${repo}`) : raw(DATA_REPO);
  }
  const DATA_ROOT = dataRoot();
  async function fetchJson(path) {
    const resp = await fetch(DATA_ROOT + path, { cache: "no-cache" });
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Failed to load ${DATA_ROOT + path} (${resp.status})`);
    return resp.json();
  }
  function showError(err) {
    const chartEl = document.getElementById("fp-chart");
    if (window.Plotly) Plotly.purge(chartEl);
    chartEl.innerHTML = `<div style="padding:24px;color:#b91c1c">${err.message}. ` +
      `If you're viewing this via file://, serve the directory over HTTP (e.g. <code>quarto preview</code>).</div>`;
  }

  // Each location's data is fetched the first time it's selected and kept for the rest of the visit.
  const locationCache = new Map();
  function loadLocation(id) {
    if (!locationCache.has(id)) {
      const p = fetchJson(`locations/${id}.json`);
      p.catch(() => locationCache.delete(id));  // let a failed fetch be retried
      locationCache.set(id, p);
    }
    return locationCache.get(id);
  }

  // Start fetching the default location alongside options.json rather than after it.
  const DEFAULT_LOCATION = "texas";
  loadLocation(DEFAULT_LOCATION).catch(() => {});
  let DATA;
  try {
    DATA = await fetchJson("options.json");
  } catch (err) {
    showError(err);
    return;
  }
  const MODEL_COLORS = { Ensemble: "#2563eb" };

  const state = {
    region: null,
    locData: null,
    viewMode: "trajectories",
    pastSeasons: "all",  // "last" (last season only) or "all"
    enabledModels: new Set(["Ensemble"]),
  };

  const QUANTILE_LEVELS = [0.025, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.975];
  const N_TRAJ_DRAWS = 30;  // how many sample paths to render in trajectories view

  // Epidemic trend card: a trajectory counts as increasing/decreasing if it changes by at least
  // TREND_CHANGE (relative) from the last observation; a category is reported only if at least
  // TREND_AGREEMENT of trajectories fall in it, otherwise the trend is "Uncertain". A relative change
  // is undefined when the last observation is 0, so then a trajectory counts as increasing if it
  // reaches TREND_ZERO_CHANGE (percentage points; 5% of the median last observation across locations).
  const TREND_CHANGE = 0.05;
  const TREND_ZERO_CHANGE = 0.03;
  const TREND_AGREEMENT = 0.65;
  // Epidemic level card: flag a location as "unstable" if its observations are noisy, measured as
  // the SD of log values around a centered 3-week rolling mean, or if many weeks are reported as 0.
  const UNSTABLE_RESID_SD = 0.5;
  const UNSTABLE_ZERO_FRAC = 0.2;
  // Peak cards: only shown when the ensemble's trajectories run through at least this month-day
  // in the second calendar year of the season, so the peak isn't read off a truncated forecast.
  const PEAK_FORECAST_MIN_END = "05-01";
  const svgIcon = path => `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">${path}</svg>`;
  const TREND_CATEGORIES = {
    increasing: { label: "Increasing", verb: "rising",    color: "#b91c1c", iconBg: "#dc2626",
                  icon: svgIcon('<path d="M5 17 17 5"/><path d="M8 5h9v9"/>') },
    stable:     { label: "Stable",     verb: "stable",    color: "#a16207", iconBg: "#eab308",
                  icon: svgIcon('<path d="M4 12h15"/><path d="M13 6l6 6-6 6"/>') },
    decreasing: { label: "Decreasing", verb: "declining", color: "#1d4ed8", iconBg: "#2563eb",
                  icon: svgIcon('<path d="M5 7 17 19"/><path d="M17 10v9H8"/>') },
    uncertain:  { label: "Uncertain",  verb: null,        color: "#475569", iconBg: "#94a3b8",
                  icon: svgIcon('<path d="M9.1 9a3 3 0 0 1 5.8 1c0 2-3 3-3 3"/><path d="M12 17h.01"/>') },
  };

  // Default region: prefer DEFAULT_LOCATION if present, else first.
  const defaultLoc = DATA.locations.find(l => l.id === DEFAULT_LOCATION) || DATA.locations[0];
  state.region = defaultLoc.id;

  async function selectRegion(id) {
    state.region = id;
    document.body.classList.add("fp-loading");
    let locData;
    try {
      locData = await loadLocation(id);
    } catch (err) {
      if (state.region === id) { document.body.classList.remove("fp-loading"); showError(err); }
      return;
    }
    if (state.region !== id) return;  // another location was picked while this one loaded
    document.body.classList.remove("fp-loading");
    state.locData = locData;
    render();
  }

  // Populate region dropdown
  const regionSel = document.getElementById("fp-region");
  for (const loc of DATA.locations) {
    const opt = document.createElement("option");
    opt.value = loc.id;
    opt.textContent = loc.name;
    if (loc.id === state.region) opt.selected = true;
    regionSel.appendChild(opt);
  }
  regionSel.addEventListener("change", e => selectRegion(e.target.value));

  // Toggle buttons: each sets state[key] to the clicked button's data-v
  function bindToggle(id, key) {
    document.querySelectorAll(`#${id} button`).forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        state[key] = btn.dataset.v;
        document.querySelectorAll(`#${id} button`).forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("active", b === btn));
        if (state.locData) render();
      });
    });
  }
  bindToggle("fp-viewmode", "viewMode");
  bindToggle("fp-pastseasons", "pastSeasons");

  // Static labels
  document.getElementById("fp-ref-date").textContent = DATA.reference_date;
  document.getElementById("fp-season-label").textContent = DATA.season_label;
  document.getElementById("fp-last-year-label").textContent = `Last year (${DATA.season - 1}-${DATA.season})`;

  // ---------- helpers ----------
  function weekOfYear(dateStr) {
    const d = new Date(dateStr + "T00:00:00Z");
    const start = new Date(Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(), 0, 1));
    const diff = (d - start) / 86400000;
    return Math.floor((diff + start.getUTCDay()) / 7) + 1;
  }
  function addDays(dateStr, days) {
    const d = new Date(dateStr + "T00:00:00Z");
    return new Date(d.getTime() + days * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }
  function quantileInArray(arr, val) {
    if (!arr.length) return null;
    const sorted = [...arr].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    let count = 0;
    for (const x of sorted) if (x <= val) count++;
    return Math.round((count / sorted.length) * 100);
  }
  function ordinal(n) {
    if (n == null) return "—";
    const s = ["th", "st", "nd", "rd"], v = n % 100;
    return n + (s[(v - 20) % 10] || s[v] || s[0]);
  }
  function quantilesOf(values, levels) {
    if (!values.length) return levels.map(() => null);
    const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    return levels.map(p => {
      const i = p * (sorted.length - 1);
      const lo = Math.floor(i), hi = Math.ceil(i);
      return sorted[lo] + (sorted[hi] - sorted[lo]) * (i - lo);
    });
  }
  function quantileBandsByDate(samples) {
    // samples: [[w1,w2,...wN], ...]; returns {q025, q25, q50, q75, q975} arrays of length N
    if (!samples.length) return null;
    const N = samples[0].length;
    const out = { q025: [], q25: [], q50: [], q75: [], q975: [] };
    for (let t = 0; t < N; t++) {
      const col = samples.map(s => s[t]);
      const [q025, q25, q50, q75, q975] = quantilesOf(col, [0.025, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.975]);
      out.q025.push(q025); out.q25.push(q25); out.q50.push(q50);
      out.q75.push(q75); out.q975.push(q975);
    }
    return out;
  }
  function seasonOf(dateStr) {
    // Flu season (Aug 1 → Jul 31), identified by the year it starts in.
    const y = parseInt(dateStr.slice(0, 4));
    const m = parseInt(dateStr.slice(5, 7));
    return m >= 8 ? y : y - 1;
  }
  function noiseStats(rows) {
    // rows: [{date, value}, ...] sorted by date; returns {residSd, zeroFrac} (see UNSTABLE_* above).
    const vals = rows.filter(r => r.value != null).map(r => r.value);
    if (vals.length < 3) return null;
    const zeroFrac = vals.filter(v => v === 0).length / vals.length;
    const y = vals.map(v => Math.log(Math.max(v, 0.01)));
    const resid = [];
    for (let i = 1; i < y.length - 1; i++) resid.push(y[i] - (y[i - 1] + y[i] + y[i + 1]) / 3);
    const mean = resid.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / resid.length;
    const residSd = Math.sqrt(resid.reduce((a, b) => a + (b - mean) ** 2, 0) / resid.length);
    return { residSd, zeroFrac };
  }
  function historicalSeasonPeaks(history, beforeSeason) {
    // Group observations by flu season and return {season, peak, date} for seasons before `beforeSeason`.
    if (!history || !history.length) return [];
    const byseason = {};
    for (const r of history) {
      if (r.value == null) continue;
      const seasonYear = seasonOf(r.date);
      if (seasonYear >= beforeSeason) continue;
      if (!(seasonYear in byseason) || r.value > byseason[seasonYear].peak) {
        byseason[seasonYear] = { season: seasonYear, peak: r.value, date: r.date };
      }
    }
    return Object.values(byseason);
  }
  function levelCategory(pct) {
    // pct = percentile (0-100) of value vs same-week historical observations
    if (pct == null) return { label: "—", color: "#64748b" };
    if (pct >= 90) return { label: "Far above average", color: "#b91c1c" };
    if (pct >= 66) return { label: "Above average",     color: "#c2410c" };
    if (pct >= 33) return { label: "Average",           color: "#475569" };
    if (pct >= 10) return { label: "Below average",     color: "#15803d" };
    return                  { label: "Far below average", color: "#166534" };
  }
  function peakStatsFromSamples(samples, dates, observedPeak) {
    // For each sample, the season peak is the larger of the peak observed so far this season
    // (observedPeak: {date, value} or null) and the sample's own max: returns {peakValues, peakDates}
    const peakValues = [], peakDates = [];
    for (const s of samples) {
      let bestI = 0, best = s[0];
      for (let i = 1; i < s.length; i++) { if (s[i] > best) { best = s[i]; bestI = i; } }
      if (observedPeak && observedPeak.value >= best) {
        peakValues.push(observedPeak.value);
        peakDates.push(observedPeak.date);
      } else {
        peakValues.push(best);
        peakDates.push(dates[bestI]);
      }
    }
    return { peakValues, peakDates };
  }
  function trace(name, x, y, opts = {}) {
    return Object.assign({ type: "scatter", mode: "lines+markers", name, x, y }, opts);
  }

  // ---------- render ----------
  function render() {
    // history: all observations through the reference date; forecasts: {model label: {dates, samples}}
    const { observed: history, forecasts } = state.locData;
    const refSeason = DATA.season;
    const observed = history.filter(r => seasonOf(r.date) === refSeason);

    const ensemble = forecasts.Ensemble;
    const lastObs = observed.length ? observed[observed.length - 1].value : null;
    const lastObsDate = observed.length ? observed[observed.length - 1].date : null;

    // ---- Card 2: Epidemic level (colored categories, vs same week in past seasons) ----
    const levelCurEl = document.getElementById("fp-level-current");
    const levelFutEl = document.getElementById("fp-level-future");
    const levelSubEl = document.getElementById("fp-level-sub");
    const levelWarnEl = document.getElementById("fp-level-warning");
    // Only seasons before the forecast's season are used as the comparison set, so the current
    // season (including the value being ranked, and any later data) never leaks in.
    const pastHistory = history.filter(r => r.value != null && seasonOf(r.date) < refSeason);
    const histRowsForWeek = (wk) => pastHistory.filter(r => Math.abs(weekOfYear(r.date) - wk) <= 1);
    const histValuesForWeek = (wk) => histRowsForWeek(wk).map(r => r.value);
    let nSeasonsUsed = 0;
    if (lastObs != null && lastObsDate) {
      const wk = weekOfYear(lastObsDate);
      const histVals = histValuesForWeek(wk);
      nSeasonsUsed = new Set(histRowsForWeek(wk).map(r => seasonOf(r.date))).size;
      const p = quantileInArray(histVals, lastObs);
      const cat = levelCategory(p);
      levelCurEl.textContent = cat.label;
      levelCurEl.style.color = cat.color;
    } else {
      levelCurEl.textContent = "—"; levelCurEl.style.color = "";
    }
    const futureDate = lastObsDate ? addDays(lastObsDate, 28) : null;
    const futureIdx = ensemble && futureDate ? ensemble.dates.indexOf(futureDate) : -1;
    if (futureIdx >= 0 && ensemble.samples.length) {
      const futureMedian = quantilesOf(ensemble.samples.map(s => s[futureIdx]), [0.5])[0];
      const wk = weekOfYear(futureDate);
      const histVals = histValuesForWeek(wk);
      const p = quantileInArray(histVals, futureMedian);
      const cat = levelCategory(p);
      levelFutEl.textContent = cat.label;
      levelFutEl.style.color = cat.color;
    } else {
      levelFutEl.textContent = "—"; levelFutEl.style.color = "";
    }
    levelSubEl.textContent = nSeasonsUsed
      ? `Compared with the same time of year in ${nSeasonsUsed} past season${nSeasonsUsed === 1 ? "" : "s"}`
      : "";
    const noise = noiseStats(history.filter(r => r.date <= DATA.reference_date));
    levelWarnEl.hidden = !(noise && (noise.residSd > UNSTABLE_RESID_SD || noise.zeroFrac > UNSTABLE_ZERO_FRAC));

    // ---- Card 1: Epidemic trend (last observation vs. ensemble trajectories 2 weeks later) ----
    const trendCardEl = document.getElementById("fp-trend-card");
    const trendIconEl = document.getElementById("fp-trend-icon");
    const trendLabelEl = document.getElementById("fp-trend-label");
    const trendStatEl = document.getElementById("fp-trend-stat");
    const trendSubEl = document.getElementById("fp-trend-sub");
    const fmtMd = ds => {
      const d = new Date(ds + "T00:00:00Z");
      return d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" });
    };
    const trendTargetDate = lastObsDate ? addDays(lastObsDate, 14) : null;
    const trendIdx = ensemble && trendTargetDate ? ensemble.dates.indexOf(trendTargetDate) : -1;
    trendCardEl.classList.remove(...Object.keys(TREND_CATEGORIES).map(k => `trend-${k}`));
    if (trendIdx >= 0 && lastObs != null && ensemble.samples.length) {
      const n = ensemble.samples.length;
      const counts = { increasing: 0, stable: 0, decreasing: 0 };
      // Compare in absolute terms (percentage points) so the same test covers both cases.
      const threshold = lastObs > 0 ? TREND_CHANGE * lastObs : TREND_ZERO_CHANGE;
      for (const s of ensemble.samples) {
        const change = s[trendIdx] - lastObs;
        if (change >= threshold) counts.increasing++;
        else if (change <= -threshold) counts.decreasing++;
        else counts.stable++;
      }
      // At most one category can reach the agreement threshold (it's > 50%).
      const key = Object.keys(counts).find(k => counts[k] / n >= TREND_AGREEMENT) || "uncertain";
      const cat = TREND_CATEGORIES[key];
      trendCardEl.classList.add(`trend-${key}`);
      trendIconEl.innerHTML = cat.icon;
      trendIconEl.style.background = cat.iconBg;
      trendLabelEl.textContent = cat.label;
      trendLabelEl.style.color = cat.color;
      trendStatEl.textContent = key === "uncertain"
        ? "Future trajectories show mixed patterns"
        : `${Math.round(counts[key] / n * 100)}% of trajectories are ${cat.verb}`;
      trendStatEl.style.color = cat.color;
      trendSubEl.textContent = `From the week ending ${fmtMd(lastObsDate)} to the week ending ${fmtMd(trendTargetDate)}`;
    } else {
      trendIconEl.innerHTML = "";
      trendLabelEl.textContent = "—"; trendLabelEl.style.color = "";
      trendStatEl.textContent = "";
      trendSubEl.textContent = "";
    }

    // ---- Card 3 (Expected peak week) + Card 4 (Expected season peak) ----
    const peakWeekEl = document.getElementById("fp-peak-week");
    const peakWeekSubEl = document.getElementById("fp-peak-week-sub");
    const peakWeekHistEl = document.getElementById("fp-peak-week-hist");
    const peakValEl = document.getElementById("fp-peak-value");
    const peakVsLastEl = document.getElementById("fp-peak-vs-last");
    const peakVsLastProbEl = document.getElementById("fp-peak-vs-last-prob");

    const fullSeason = ensemble && ensemble.dates.length &&
      ensemble.dates[ensemble.dates.length - 1] >= `${refSeason + 1}-${PEAK_FORECAST_MIN_END}`;
    const observedPeak = observed.reduce((best, r) => (!best || r.value > best.value ? r : best), null);
    if (fullSeason && ensemble.samples.length) {
      const stats = peakStatsFromSamples(ensemble.samples, ensemble.dates, observedPeak);
      const [pvLo, pvMd, pvHi] = quantilesOf(stats.peakValues, [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]);
      const histPeaks = historicalSeasonPeaks(history, refSeason);
      const fmt = ds => {
        const d = new Date(ds + "T00:00:00Z");
        return d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" });
      };

      // --- Card 3: peak week ---
      // Median peak week (taken from the sorted dates, so it is always a real forecast week and
      // always falls inside the 50% PI, unlike the most common week).
      const sortedPeakDates = [...stats.peakDates].sort();
      const pick = p => sortedPeakDates[Math.floor(p * (sortedPeakDates.length - 1))];
      const medianDate = pick(0.5);
      peakWeekEl.textContent = fmt(medianDate);
      peakWeekSubEl.textContent = `50% PI: ${fmt(pick(0.25))} – ${fmt(pick(0.75))}`;

      if (histPeaks.length) {
        // Normalize calendar weeks around the new year so wraparound averages correctly:
        // late-year weeks (e.g. week 50) shift to negative (-2), Jan weeks stay positive.
        const normalize = w => w >= 27 ? w - 52 : w;
        const histWeeksNorm = histPeaks.map(p => normalize(weekOfYear(p.date)));
        const meanHistWeek = histWeeksNorm.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / histWeeksNorm.length;
        const forecastWeek = normalize(weekOfYear(medianDate));
        const diffWeeks = forecastWeek - meanHistWeek;
        let text, color;
        if (diffWeeks <= -2.5)        { text = `~${Math.round(Math.abs(diffWeeks))} weeks earlier than usual`; color = "#c2410c"; }
        else if (diffWeeks <= -0.75)  { text = "Slightly earlier than usual"; color = "#c2410c"; }
        else if (diffWeeks < 0.75)    { text = "About the same time as usual"; color = "#475569"; }
        else if (diffWeeks < 2.5)     { text = "Slightly later than usual"; color = "#ca8a04"; }
        else                          { text = `~${Math.round(diffWeeks)} weeks later than usual`; color = "#ca8a04"; }
        peakWeekHistEl.textContent = text;
        peakWeekHistEl.style.color = color;
        peakWeekHistEl.style.fontWeight = "600";
      } else {
        peakWeekHistEl.textContent = "";
      }

      // --- Card 4: peak comparison (primary) + value (secondary) ---
      const lastSeasonPeakObj = histPeaks.find(p => p.season === refSeason - 1);
      if (lastSeasonPeakObj) {
        const lastPk = lastSeasonPeakObj.peak;
        const deltaPct = (pvMd - lastPk) / lastPk * 100;
        let dirLabel, dirColor, dirWord, probDir;
        if (deltaPct >= 0) {
          dirWord = "higher";
          probDir = stats.peakValues.filter(v => v > 1.20 * lastPk).length / stats.peakValues.length;
        } else {
          dirWord = "lower";
          probDir = stats.peakValues.filter(v => v < 0.80 * lastPk).length / stats.peakValues.length;
        }
        if (Math.abs(deltaPct) <= 20) { dirLabel = "Similar to last year";  dirColor = "#475569"; }
        else if (deltaPct > 20)       { dirLabel = "Higher than last year"; dirColor = "#b91c1c"; }
        else                          { dirLabel = "Lower than last year";  dirColor = "#15803d"; }
        peakVsLastEl.textContent = dirLabel;
        peakVsLastEl.style.color = dirColor;
        peakValEl.textContent = `Forecast peak: ${pvMd.toFixed(1)}% (last yr: ${lastPk.toFixed(1)}%)`;
        peakVsLastProbEl.textContent = `${Math.round(probDir * 100)}% chance peak is more than 20% ${dirWord} than last year`;
      } else {
        peakVsLastEl.textContent = "Last season unavailable";
        peakVsLastEl.style.color = "#94a3b8";
        peakValEl.textContent = `Forecast peak: ${pvMd.toFixed(1)}%`;
        peakVsLastProbEl.textContent = "";
      }
    } else {
      peakWeekEl.textContent = "—"; peakWeekSubEl.textContent = ""; peakWeekHistEl.textContent = "";
      peakValEl.textContent = "—"; peakVsLastEl.textContent = "—"; peakVsLastProbEl.textContent = "";
      peakVsLastEl.style.color = "";
      if (ensemble) {
        peakWeekSubEl.textContent = peakVsLastProbEl.textContent =
          "Needs a full-season forecast, which isn't available this week";
      }
    }

    // ---- Chart ----
    const traces = [];

    // Past seasons, drawn under the current one. A season k years back is shifted forward by the
    // whole number of weeks closest to k years, so weeks still end on Saturdays and land within
    // half a week of the same time of year.
    const LAST_SEASON_COLOR = "#64748b";
    const pastSeasons = [...new Set(history.map(r => seasonOf(r.date)))]
      .filter(s => s < refSeason && (state.pastSeasons === "all" || s === refSeason - 1))
      .sort((a, b) => a - b);
    for (const s of pastSeasons) {
      const rows = history.filter(r => seasonOf(r.date) === s);
      const shiftDays = Math.round((refSeason - s) * 365.25 / 7) * 7;
      const isLast = s === refSeason - 1;
      const label = `${s}-${s + 1}`;
      traces.push(trace(label, rows.map(r => addDays(r.date, shiftDays)), rows.map(r => r.value), {
        mode: isLast ? "lines+markers" : "lines",
        line: { color: isLast ? LAST_SEASON_COLOR : "#a8b4c4", width: 1.8 },
        marker: { color: LAST_SEASON_COLOR, size: 4 },
        opacity: isLast ? 0.9 : 0.85,
        customdata: rows.map(r => r.date),
        hovertemplate: `${label}<br>Week ending %{customdata}: %{y:.2f}%<extra></extra>`,
        showlegend: false,
      }));
    }
    const older = pastSeasons.filter(s => s < refSeason - 1);
    document.getElementById("fp-older-legend").style.display = older.length ? "" : "none";
    document.getElementById("fp-older-label").textContent = older.length === 1
      ? `Earlier season (${older[0]}-${older[0] + 1})`
      : `Earlier seasons (${older.length}: ${older[0]}-${older[0] + 1} to ${older[older.length - 1]}-${older[older.length - 1] + 1})`;

    // Observed (current season)
    const obsX = observed.map(r => r.date);
    const obsY = observed.map(r => r.value);
    traces.push(trace("Observed", obsX, obsY, {
      line: { color: "#0f172a", width: 2.5 },
      marker: { color: "#0f172a", size: 5 },
      showlegend: false,
    }));

    document.getElementById("fp-forecast-legend-detail").textContent = !ensemble ? "(not available)"
      : state.viewMode === "intervals" ? "(median, 50% and 95% intervals)"
      : `(${Math.min(N_TRAJ_DRAWS, ensemble.samples.length)} of ${ensemble.samples.length} trajectories shown)`;

    // Forecasts (per enabled model)
    for (const m of DATA.models) {
      if (!state.enabledModels.has(m)) continue;
      const f = forecasts[m];
      if (!f || !f.samples.length) continue;
      const color = MODEL_COLORS[m];
      const x = f.dates;

      if (state.viewMode === "intervals") {
        const bands = quantileBandsByDate(f.samples);
        // 95% band
        traces.push({
          type: "scatter", mode: "lines",
          x: [...x, ...x.slice().reverse()],
          y: [...bands.q975, ...bands.q025.slice().reverse()],
          fill: "toself", fillcolor: color + "26",
          line: { color: "transparent" },
          name: `${m} 95%`, hoverinfo: "skip", showlegend: false,
        });
        // 50% band
        traces.push({
          type: "scatter", mode: "lines",
          x: [...x, ...x.slice().reverse()],
          y: [...bands.q75, ...bands.q25.slice().reverse()],
          fill: "toself", fillcolor: color + "4D",
          line: { color: "transparent" },
          name: `${m} 50%`, hoverinfo: "skip", showlegend: false,
        });
        // Median, connected to last observed point
        let connX = x, connY = bands.q50;
        if (lastObs != null) {
          connX = [lastObsDate, ...x];
          connY = [lastObs, ...bands.q50];
        }
        traces.push(trace(m, connX, connY, {
          mode: "lines",
          line: { color, width: 2.5, dash: "dash" },
        }));
      } else {
        // Trajectories: draw N_TRAJ_DRAWS individual sample paths
        const nDraws = Math.min(N_TRAJ_DRAWS, f.samples.length);
        const indices = Array.from({ length: nDraws }, (_, j) => Math.floor(j * f.samples.length / nDraws));
        indices.forEach((idx, j) => {
          let lineX = x, lineY = f.samples[idx];
          if (lastObs != null) {
            lineX = [lastObsDate, ...x];
            lineY = [lastObs, ...f.samples[idx]];
          }
          traces.push({
            type: "scatter", mode: "lines",
            x: lineX, y: lineY,
            line: { color, width: 1 },
            opacity: 0.25,
            name: j === 0 ? m : `${m} draw`,
            showlegend: j === 0,
            hoverinfo: "skip",
          });
        });
      }
    }

    const layout = {
      margin: { t: 10, r: 20, b: 50, l: 50 },
      xaxis: {
        type: "date",
        showgrid: true, gridcolor: "#eef2f7",
        tickfont: { size: 11, color: "#64748b" },
        title: { text: "" },
      },
      yaxis: {
        title: { text: "ED Percent Flu", font: { size: 12, color: "#475569" } },
        showgrid: true, gridcolor: "#eef2f7",
        tickfont: { size: 11, color: "#64748b" },
        rangemode: "tozero",
      },
      legend: { orientation: "h", x: 0, y: 1.12, font: { size: 11 } },
      plot_bgcolor: "#fff",
      paper_bgcolor: "#fff",
      shapes: [{
        type: "line", xref: "x", yref: "paper",
        x0: DATA.reference_date, x1: DATA.reference_date, y0: 0, y1: 1,
        line: { color: "#cbd5e1", width: 1, dash: "dot" },
      }],
      annotations: [{
        x: DATA.reference_date, xref: "x", y: 1.02, yref: "paper",
        text: "Forecast date", showarrow: false,
        font: { size: 10, color: "#94a3b8" },
      }],
    };

    Plotly.react("fp-chart", traces, layout, { displayModeBar: false, responsive: true });
  }

  selectRegion(state.region);
})();
</script>
```
